scope_note: Selected outline-source and ADR review only. Producer restrictions, implementation choices, and visible consumer behavior are kept distinct.

decisions.review: Its count algorithm is consistent with Table 151. Its cycle guard and decision to follow First/Next only are implementation choices; #139 now prohibits Next on a last item and Prev on a first item, but no standard text prescribes a malformed-cycle recovery result. Also, the original no-panel framing predates the current panel behavior.
decisions.disposition: Retain count/list rationale with cycle handling labeled defensive policy, not a reader duty. Treat ADR 0144 as the later visible-panel/activation decision.

decisions.review: Current code and tests cover linked display order, C color, F style data, and activation routes. The public panel draws C and interacts with Count; the newly supplied raster draft addresses the remaining visual assertion for F bits. The source's permission to display the outline does not require a panel in every processor.
decisions.disposition: Retain; narrow evidence claims to distinguish model/script values from visible styling assertions until the F draft is run.

decisions.review: Direct primary caret annotations insert a SHALL prohibition on Prev at first and Next at last. This makes those producer shapes invalid but does not itself require a reader to refuse or recover in a particular way. Current repeated-object guard is bounded tolerance behavior.
decisions.disposition: Retain producer-side interpretation; do not promote it into an ISO mandate for cycle detection or error reporting.

decisions.review: Current hook tests project title, open state, style/color values and make execute a user-like activation request. This is a script API consumer decision layered on Table 151; it does not substitute for the visual style assertion at the Sidebar.
decisions.disposition: Retain; keep script-model and viewer panel evidence separate.
